findings.summary: Reduced-motion support is only partial
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the CSS probe found one rule that disables .btn transitions only below 992px, while modal, app-panel and other transitions remain defined.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply a global reduced-motion override for non-essential transitions and stop auto-advancing/carousel motion when reduction is requested.

findings.summary: No high-contrast or forced-colors adaptation
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast probe matched the emulated preference but found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules; axe also measured CTA contrast as low as 2.04:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast styles that preserve visible boundaries and use system colors for controls.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition CSS and the MPA does not declare cross-document view transitions, so catalog-to-detail navigation swaps instantly.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive cross-document View Transitions and respect reduced motion.

findings.summary: Carousel interaction relies on custom Flickity positioning
findings.evidence: The homepage ships flickity.pkgd.min.js and absolutely positions carousel slides; no scroll-snap evidence was found. Hidden slides also retain focusable descendants.
findings.suggestedFix: Prefer a native overflow carousel with scroll-snap and platform scrolling, retaining a lightweight fallback only where needed.

findings.summary: Long pages have static chrome with no scroll-state feedback
findings.evidence: Mobile screenshots show long 3,000+ px listing/article pages, while CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or progress indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a shrinking sticky header or article/list progress affordance driven by CSS scroll-state/scroll progress.

findings.summary: Menus and overlays use legacy manual positioning
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection shows custom fixed .modal and manually positioned .submenu rules, with no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover plus CSS anchor positioning and fallback positions for attached menus and transient UI.

findings.summary: Consent UI blocks the entire detail and article first view
findings.evidence: Mobile captures of the game detail and article show a near-full-viewport consent dialog before any page content can be read; the persistent AN1 Store panel remains behind it.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, content-preserving consent surface where legally possible, keep reject as prominent as accept, and avoid stacking it with the app-install panel.

findings.summary: Site overlays are custom div-based widgets
findings.evidence: The detail probe found .fc-consent-root and .fc-dialog-overlay with no dialog element, role=dialog or aria-modal; site search/menu overlays also use custom .modal divs.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native dialog for modal consent and popover for transient search/menu UI, with declarative dismissal and focus management.

findings.summary: Reusable cards adapt only at viewport breakpoints
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found zero @container rules; game cards are reused in carousels, grids and search but are sized through global media queries.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/list regions containment and use size container queries for local adaptations.

findings.summary: Rating targets are too small for touch
findings.evidence: The controls probe measured each 1–5 rating link at 20×20 CSS px, and Lighthouse target-size failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Make each rating choice at least 44×44 CSS px with adequate spacing and retain a visible focus indicator.

findings.summary: Unknown URLs silently become the homepage
findings.evidence: The deliberately unknown path returned HTTP 200 and rendered the homepage with no error message, retry, search, or route recovery state.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 status and a clear not-found page with search, home, and category recovery actions.

findings.summary: Image delivery leaves substantial savings
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 402 KiB image-delivery savings; the image probe found 66/67 legacy-format images, 24 without srcset, 25 oversized, and 66 without explicit dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive variants, add srcset/sizes, reserve intrinsic dimensions, and prioritize only the LCP image.

findings.summary: Unused CSS and JavaScript ship on the homepage
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 47 KiB unused JavaScript and 16 KiB unused CSS; HAR shows a 62.7 KiB legacy general bundle plus Flickity on the initial path.
findings.suggestedFix: Split template-specific CSS/JS, remove unused legacy code, and load carousel code only when the component exists.

findings.summary: Carousel and landmark semantics exclude keyboard and assistive-tech users
findings.evidence: axe found focusable links inside aria-hidden carousel slides and no main landmark; Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.85.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove hidden slides from the tab order, expose coherent carousel controls/status, and wrap primary content in main.

findings.summary: Primary CTA text fails WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: axe measured white-on-green CTA contrast at 2.04:1 and white-on-orange at 2.67:1, below 4.5:1 for the rendered text sizes.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken CTA fills or use dark text so every normal-size label reaches at least 4.5:1 in light and dark themes.

findings.summary: Small controls undermine mobile accessibility
findings.evidence: Lighthouse target-size failed and the live controls probe found multiple 20×20 rating targets, despite otherwise successful 360px reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase compact controls and rating choices to accessible target sizes without breaking narrow-screen reflow.

findings.summary: Most images omit intrinsic dimensions
findings.evidence: The images primitive reported 66 of 67 img elements without width/height attributes, weakening the document’s intrinsic layout contract even though observed CLS was currently low.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height (or equivalent aspect-ratio) for every content image and preserve the correct ratio in responsive CSS.

findings.summary: The page is not eligible for BFCache
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported one back/forward-cache failure, so returning from a game detail can require a fresh page load.
findings.suggestedFix: Inspect the Lighthouse BFCache reason and remove unload handlers or other avoidable blockers.

findings.summary: Many links have non-descriptive text
findings.evidence: Lighthouse SEO found 12 links without descriptive text; the card ratings use links labelled only 1–5 and generic MORE links appear in listings.
findings.suggestedFix: Give links purpose-specific accessible text; use buttons for in-page rating actions and descriptive pagination/category labels.

findings.summary: Public article indexing and missing-route signals conflict
findings.evidence: A prominently linked news article declares robots=noindex,nofollow, while an unknown URL returns 200 with homepage content. Both send misleading indexing signals.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove accidental noindex from public articles and return 404 for unknown URLs; keep sitemap, canonical and robots signals consistent.

findings.summary: Product and article pages omit structured data
findings.evidence: The detail and article probes found no JSON-LD, despite representing downloadable software and a news article; Open Graph is present but does not replace schema.org entities.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate SoftwareApplication and NewsArticle JSON-LD matching visible content and existing canonical/Open Graph metadata.

findings.summary: Core XSS defenses and cookie flags are missing
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no CSP or X-Content-Type-Options; both language and PHPSESSID cookies were not Secure and used SameSite=None despite HTTPS.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, nosniff, and mark first-party cookies Secure with Lax/Strict SameSite unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: Consent surface proposes data sharing with 210 partners
findings.evidence: The first-visit consent dialog states that identifiers and device data may be processed by 210 partners; denial is possible, but the default third-party surface is disproportionate to a download catalog.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce vendors to those essential for the service, avoid personalized processing by default, and document/batch the minimal analytics retained.

findings.summary: Defensive response policies are largely absent
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP frame-ancestors, or nosniff; only HSTS was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Set frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options), strict referrer and permissions policies, nosniff, and a CSP appropriate to the ad/analytics posture.

findings.summary: Installability metadata exists without an active offline controller
findings.evidence: A manifest with start_url and standalone display is present, but probes found no controlling service worker, so this app-like catalog has no verified offline fallback.
findings.suggestedFix: Register a minimal service worker that provides an offline shell/fallback for saved catalog and article routes, or remove app-like install signals if offline is intentionally unsupported.

findings.summary: HTTP failure state is replaced with misleading success content
findings.evidence: The unknown route returned 200 and the normal homepage rather than a not-found state, making broken links look successful and offering no recovery context.
findings.suggestedFix: Handle unknown routes and upstream failures explicitly with correct status codes and actionable retry/search/navigation states.

findings.summary: Multilingual layout relies on physical direction properties
findings.evidence: The site links English and Russian variants and sets lang=en, but captured CSS extensively uses left/right, margin-left and border-left with no logical-property strategy evident.
findings.suggestedFix: Set dir explicitly where needed and replace layout-critical physical properties with inline/block logical equivalents so future RTL/localized layouts remain robust.

findings.summary: Legacy and oversized images waste transfer
findings.evidence: The image audit found 66 legacy PNG/JPG assets, 25 oversized renderings and 24 responsive images without srcset; images accounted for 598 KiB of the 786 KiB homepage transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Create modern responsive image variants, right-size thumbnails, and keep lazy loading for below-fold assets.

Modernize responsive image delivery and intrinsic sizing
Add structured metadata and correct article indexing
Replace custom overlay/carousel plumbing with platform primitives
Respect reduced-motion and high-contrast preferences completely
Trim unused template CSS/JavaScript and fix BFCache eligibility
Add local component queries and internationalization-safe logical CSS
Provide an offline fallback or remove unsupported install signals
Add progressive route transitions and optional scroll-state guidance
